name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
blurb: Responsive grid layout where items can span multiple columns.
description: BentoGrid is a CSS grid container. BentoGridItem wraps each cell with title, description, header (top content), and optional icon. Items are sized with responsive Tailwind classes. No built-in animation.
use_when: Feature showcases, dashboards, or product pages using a bento box layout.
avoid_when: When you need scroll-based animations or complex state management.
a11y: Grid items are divs with text content. Semantic structure depends on how you use them.
